lyrics:
[Intro: soft disco guitar, electric piano, light kick]

[Verse 1: sweet conversational female voice]
Used to hold my stomach in
Used to plan the way I'd walk
Used to wonder who had seen
Used to hear them when they'd talk

[Chorus: full disco-house groove, strings]
Now nobody's looking
Not a single eye
I can eat the fries, I can wear the hat
I can take my time
Nobody's looking
And I've never felt so fine

[Verse 2: voice amused, bass walking]
Boy at the bar looked right through me
Twenty years back, that would sting
I just waved and got my own drink
Free as anything

[Chorus: full disco-house groove, strings]
Now nobody's looking
Not a single eye
I can eat the fries, I can wear the hat
I can take my time
Nobody's looking
And I've never felt so fine

[Bridge: beat thins, voice close]
Well. One's looking.
Thirty years, and he still does.
That's enough.

[Final Chorus: full groove, saxophone enters]
Nobody's looking
Not a single eye
I can eat the fries, I can wear the hat
I can take my time
Nobody's looking
And I've never felt so fine

[Sax Outro: warm saxophone solo over the groove, fading]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, D major. A soft, breezy disco-house groove, light and contented.

VOICE: Female, sweet, clear and conversational, with a smile and no strain, as if talking to a friend on the next lounger. Soft harmonies in the choruses. The bridge is nearly spoken.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean, chopped disco guitar, a Rhodes electric piano, a light four-on-the-floor kick with an open hi-hat, a walking disco bass, a small string section, handclaps, congas, a tenor saxophone that enters in the last chorus and solos out.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and electric piano. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2. 1:32 Chorus 2. 1:58 Bridge. 2:12 Final chorus, saxophone in. 2:38 Sax outro, fading to 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s nu-disco: soft, warm and airy, voice close and natural, strings and sax sweet.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Well. One's looking.' at 1:58.

STATION FIT: 12:30 p.m., lunch. A relaxed vocal track in the exact style of the acts Pandora lists for the station.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Remembering the worry, shrugging, delighted, loved by one.
